name: ID
meaning: The product's ID, its prefix, such as TL.

name: Title
meaning: The product's name, such as Tool Library.

name: Description
meaning: What the product is, who it is for and what it must do, in a paragraph.

name: Icon
meaning: An emoji or short text shown for the product in the app's space rail.

name: Color
meaning: A CSS color for the product in the app's space rail.

name: Notes
meaning: Longer notes on the product, such as how it is delivered.

name: Name
meaning: The kind's name, in lower case with underscores, which is also its table's name; it must not be a table Lathe already has.

name: Product
meaning: The product that declares it; only that product's records may be of the kind.

name: Label
meaning: The kind's name as people read it, such as Report.

name: Description
meaning: What a record of the kind is.

name: Parent kind
meaning: The kind its records sit under, their one parent: one of Lathe's or another product kind. Its table gets a required <parent_kind>_id column.

name: Stage
meaning: The stage its records belong to, any of the five, if one; such as technical-specification for a kind of code Lathe has no kind for.

name: Obligation
meaning: Whether a record of the kind is an obligation, to be designed, built and proved. An obligation kind joins the obligation supertype.

name: Id pattern
meaning: How its IDs are written, its own pattern, such as <command>-CLI.

name: Id example
meaning: An example ID.

name: Product
meaning: The product.

name: Name

name: Description

name: Title
meaning: The domain's name, such as Lending.

name: Product
meaning: The product it belongs to.

name: Subdomain type
meaning: core: the product's edge; supporting: needed for the core but not its edge; generic: solved the same way everywhere. It guides how much modeling the domain deserves.

name: Description
meaning: What the domain covers, in a paragraph.

name: Notes
meaning: Longer notes on the domain.

meaning: The field's place in the entity, from 1.

name: Name

name: Meaning

name: Type
meaning: Its basic type: text, whole number, decimal, date, time, date and time or yes/no; or none when a value object or an aggregate types it.

name: Type value object
meaning: The value object that is its type, if one.

name: Type aggregate
meaning: The aggregate it refers to by ID, if one. A reference within the domain is a foreign key of the entity's table; one to another domain stays a plain ID.

name: Required
meaning: true: every record gives it a value; false: it may be empty.

name: Column name
meaning: Its column's name in the table, when that differs from the field's name, such as id for the field Member ID.

name: Example
meaning: An example value.

name: In root table
meaning: true: a child entity with no table of its own, stored in its aggregate root's table (which then holds its fields as columns); left out otherwise. An entity has at most one table.

meaning: What the entity is, in a sentence or two.

name: Applies when negated

name: Name
meaning: The check's name, the key of its row across Lathe's checks and every product's.

name: Product
meaning: The product a product's own check belongs to; none for Lathe's checks.

name: Position
meaning: When it runs: Lathe's checks in position order, then each product's own.

name: Severity
meaning: What its problems are: errors, warnings, or either when its query says which for each row.

name: Summary
meaning: What it asks, in one sentence.
example: A view that no flow step happens in.

name: Explanation
meaning: What it reports, what it leaves to other checks, and how to fix what it reports.
example: A view exists because steps happen in it…

name: Query
meaning: The one SELECT that finds its problems (INV04).
example: SELECT v.id AS record, … FROM view v WHERE …

name: Kinds
meaning: The kinds it concerns, as a list of kind names; none for any kind.

name: Product
meaning: The product the settings are for.

name: Max children
meaning: The most children of one kind a record of the product should hold; 15 when the product has no row.

name: Address
meaning: Where the page is, to bookmark, share or reload.

name: Page kind
meaning: What sort of place it is: products, product, domain, record, group, checks, format or settings.

name: Focus
meaning: The record or group the page is about: a record ID, or a group's address.

name: Group kind
meaning: On a kind group's page, the kind of the focus's children shown.

name: Views
meaning: How the focus is shown, in pane order; it never changes the path.

name: Product
meaning: The product the space is.

name: Last page
meaning: The last page visited in the space, for this browser session only.

name: Last chosen
meaning: Whether it is the space the reader chose last, which stays current on a page outside every space (DS02).

name: Product
meaning: The product whose nav the row is in.

name: Row
meaning: The row: a record's ID, or a stage's or kind group's address.

name: Folded
meaning: Whether it is folded in the nav, for this browser session.

name: Space
meaning: The space whose tabs these are.

name: Active page
meaning: The page of the tab shown, which the address names.

name: Page
meaning: The page it holds, by its address path, without the views.

name: Position
meaning: Its place in the row, left to right.

name: Preview
meaning: Whether the next plain open replaces it.

name: Views
meaning: The views it has open, those its page does not offer included.

name: Pane sizes
meaning: Each open pane's weight, a whole number from 1 to 10000, which the gaps share out.

name: Wiki scroll
meaning: How far down the wiki pane was, in pixels.

name: Graph settings
meaning: The graph's layout, depth, trace, Links, minimap and filters.

name: Side bar
meaning: For each view mode, whether the side bar is open and which of its views it shows (UC12-R02).

name: Panel
meaning: Which part of the page it is: the navigation, the wiki, graph or model pane, or the side bar.

name: Shown
meaning: Whether it is on screen; a hidden panel keeps a control that brings it back.

name: Size
meaning: Its width in pixels (the navigation, the side bar), or a pane's share of the panes' width, within its limits.

name: Command ID
meaning: The command's name in the keymap, unique.

name: Title
meaning: What it does, as the palette and the shortcuts sheet show it.

name: Group
meaning: Where the shortcuts sheet lists it: Navigate, View, Graph or Lists.

name: Context
meaning: Where it applies: anywhere, on a page, while the graph shows, or in a list.

name: Handled by
meaning: Who acts on its keys: the app, the component it belongs to, or the browser.

name: Keys
meaning: The chord, or chords in sequence, as the keymap writes them.

name: Off a Mac
meaning: Its keys on other platforms, where they differ.

name: Override
meaning: The person's own binding in its place.

name: Theme ID
meaning: A built-in's name, or `custom-` and a name for one of the person's own.

name: File
meaning: The theme itself: its name, its light and dark colors and its shared tokens.

name: Built in
meaning: Whether Lathe ships it, so it is never changed (INV03).

name: Based on
meaning: The built-in theme a copy was made from, which Reset puts back.

name: Folder
meaning: The product folder it shows.

name: Bounds
meaning: Its saved size and place, and whether it was maximized or full screen.

name: Server
meaning: Where it loads Lathe from.

name: Chrome
meaning: The colors its own page last sent for its background and window controls.

name: Error count
meaning: The check errors its page last reported, for the Dock badge.

name: Folder
meaning: The folder.

name: Opened
meaning: When it was last opened, which orders the list. Not stored by the code (see findings).

name: Source
meaning: Which server it is: `serve()` in the shell or from `lathe serve`, a Vite dev server the shell starts, or the shared 5199 dev server.

name: Folder
meaning: The product folder it reads.

name: Port
meaning: Where it answers; never 5199 for one the shell starts (INV06).

name: Chosen theme
meaning: The theme in use, by its ID; Lathe when it is gone (INV04).

name: Color mode
meaning: System (the default, following the system), Light or Dark.

name: Root folder
meaning: The product repo's folder.

name: Data folder
meaning: Where its data files are, as `lathe.config.json`'s `data` names it; `data` unless set.

name: Follower
meaning: The ID of the domain or use case that follows the pattern.

name: Pattern
meaning: The pattern followed.

name: Setting
meaning: One of the pattern's settings (a `pattern_setting` name).

name: Value
meaning: What the setting is for this follower.
example: The member's name and a valid email address.

name: Not applicable reason
meaning: Why the setting does not apply to this follower, in place of a value.
